title: Runway rebalance + price sensitivity (feature-driven)
body:
Executive summary:
This workbook captures a feature-led reallocation of the FY26 runway with explicit pricing-sensitivity scenarios tied to per-feature token economics. Primary objective: find minimal headcount and cost moves that recover 3–6 months of runway under plausible price erosion (-20% to +10%) and adoption of quantization profiles.

Key questions we answer here:
- If average price per 1k tokens falls by 15%, which features must be throttled or moved to Dedicated capacity to preserve margin?
- Which headcount reductions (by role) yield the largest net runway gain while preserving core SLA-backed routes?
- What is the break-even price per 1k tokens to sustain current hiring plans without using reserves?

Assumptions (sourcing & calculation notes):
- Baseline revenue mix: Hosted API 65%, Dedicated 25%, Private 10% (by dollars).
- Average price baseline = $0.60 per 1k tokens (weighted across routes).
- Typical token mix: 70% generation, 30% embedding/rerank. Generation avg tokens/call = 150.
- GPU cost drivers: reserved GPU blended cost = $2.10/hour; spot/burst blended cost = $1.40/hour.
- Quantization adoption: moving 30% of served models to 8-bit reduces token-level infra cost by 18% for those routes.
- Fully-loaded HC cost (avg): Eng IC = $200k/year, Senior Eng = $280k/year, MLE = $220k/year, Product = $185k/year, SRE = $210k/year. Benefits & taxes add 28%.

Sheet A — Headcount plan (quarterly snapshots):
Columns: role | Q2 headcount | Q3 plan delta | Q4 plan delta | FY26 total cost impact (annualized)
- Eng IC | 38 | -6 | -2 | -$2,800,000
- Senior Eng | 12 | -2 | 0 | -$560,000
- MLE | 8 | -1 | 0 | -$220,000
- Product | 7 | -1 | 0 | -$185,000
- SRE | 6 | 0 | -1 | -$210,000
- Operations / Billing | 5 | 0 | 0 | -$0
Notes: headcount deltas are staged (Q3 reductions mostly via contractors not renewed; Q4 has a final compression of non-customer-facing roles). Annualized cost impact includes fully-loaded salary + hiring churn.

Sheet B — Capacity & infra rebalancing (planned moves):
- Move 18% of burst traffic routes to Dedicated pools (saves ~11% infra cost for those routes if utilization >60%).
- Implement prefix KV cache aggressively for top-20 clients -> expected token cost reduction 7–9% for hosted route.
- Target quantization on low-latency routes (search/rerank) where quality delta measured as <0.8% QoQ drift.

Budget summary (high level):
- Baseline monthly burn (Feb 2026): $5.1M
- Target trimmed monthly burn after planned moves: $4.25M (net saving ~ $850k/month)
- Runway at current cash (as of Feb 2026): 18.2 months baseline -> increases to 22.7 months under planned moves

Pricing sensitivity scenarios (per 1k tokens) — impact to revenue & runway:
Scenario definitions:
- Upside (+10% price): $0.66 per 1k tokens
- Base (0%): $0.60 per 1k tokens
- Down -10%: $0.54 per 1k tokens
- Down -15%: $0.51 per 1k tokens
- Down -20%: $0.48 per 1k tokens

Quick math (simplified):
- Monthly token volume (weighted) = 2.1 billion tokens -> baseline monthly revenue = 2.1M * $0.60 = $1.26M (note: this is net of embeddings being priced differently; this cell represents weighted avg only)
- Each -10% price step reduces monthly rev by ~$126k. Over 12 months, -15% -> ~$226k loss/month vs baseline.

Runway impact table (illustrative):
- Baseline: runway = 18.2 months
- With planned savings: runway = 22.7 months
- If price -15% but savings implemented: runway ≈ 19.3 months (net +1.1 months vs baseline)
- If price -20% and savings NOT implemented: runway ≈ 14.5 months
- Break-even price to sustain original hiring plan (no HC cuts, no infra moves) ≈ $0.57 per 1k tokens (i.e., ~5% dip tolerated)

Feature-level sensitivity (per-feature marginal P&L):
We evaluated top 6 revenue features (chat-core, embeddings-bulk, semantic-search, code-generation, summarization, reranking). For each feature we calculate margin delta per -10% price shock and recommended action. Example snapshot:
- Chat-core: token intensity high; margin drop -12% per -10% price. Action: move non-enterprise tenants off Hosted to Dedicated or add usage floor.
- Embeddings-bulk: price-insensitive (enterprise passthrough); margin stable. Action: prioritize upsells.
- Code-generation: high variance, recommend gating large batch jobs behind commitment slabs.

Triggers & action matrix (operational playbook):
- If realized price falls >10% for two consecutive months -> freeze non-critical hiring and postpone 3 planned feature launches.
- If monthly token volume grows >25% QoQ and average utilization on Dedicated pools >70% -> accelerate Dedicated capacity purchases and reclassify top clients to reserved pricing.
- If quantization rollout fails quality gates for >2 routes -> revert to baseline for those routes and reallocate 40% of planned infra savings to burst budget.

Sensitivity walk (short):
- Small pricing slip (-5%): absorb via cache & batching, no HC changes.
- Medium (-10% to -15%): need HC restraint + targeted Dedicated migration.
- Severe (-20%+): require both HC reductions and deeper product gating (feature throttles + soft paywall for high-intensity use).

Risks & open questions:
- Elasticity uncertainty: enterprise customers may be stickier; consumer-driven token mix could compress price faster than modeled.
- Model mix shift: new large LLM entrants with cheaper models could change cost basis faster than we can quantize.
- Timing: savings assume quantization & KV cache rollouts complete by end of Q3 — slippage erodes runway improvements.

Immediate asks for finance leadership:
1) Approve runway-preservation tranche: up to $1.2M one-time reserve to cover Q3 transition costs (contractor payouts, migration credits for Enterprise as we move to Dedicated).
2) Sign-off on hiring freeze mechanics for Eng IC and Product until price moves stabilize for 2 months.
3) Prioritize billing feature to implement usage floors / commitment slabs by May 15 to protect against low-margin bulk jobs.

Appendix (quick reference tables):
1) Fully-loaded cost per role (annual, with benefits): Eng IC $256k; Senior Eng $358k; MLE $282k; Product $236k; SRE $270k.
2) Shortcut: monthly revenue delta per 1c change in price per 1k tokens = monthly tokens (2.1B) / 1000 * $0.01 = $21k/month per cent.

Notes-to-self / collaboration thread snippets:
- Noah: run sensitivity with alt token volume cases (±30%).
- Ava: confirm contract termination costs for 6 Eng IC headcount (range: $150k–$320k one-time).
- Diego: break down Dedicated vs Hosted margin by client cohort (enterprise vs self-serve).

Next checkpoints:
- Mar 20: review with FP&A and GTM for pricing floor mechanics.
- Apr 5: final sign-off on HC reductions and reserve tranche.

Document history: draft created 2026-02-18; iterated 2026-03-02 with updated quantization estimates; current version 2026-03-12 incorporates early billing modeling from Product.
